borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
description: Conversion of the dwelling into two flats (1x 4bed and 1x 2bed)
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be commenced before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>No development above ground level shall take place until details of refuse enclosures showing the design; location and external appearance have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved enclosures shall be provided before the commencement of the use and thereafter permanently retained.</p>

<p>The development hereby approved shall only be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><ul><li>Site Plan as Proposed - drawing no.250803 L 301 - dated 09.03.26</li><li>Plans as Proposed - drawing no.250803 L 303 - dated 09.03.26</li><li>Elevations as Proposed - drawing no.250803 L 305 - dated 09.03.26</li><li>Design and Access Statement &amp; Planning Statement</li><li>Site Waste Management Plan</li><li>Biodiversity Net Gain Exemption Statement</li><li>Planning fire safety strategy&nbsp;</li></ul><p>No other drawings or documents apply.</p>

<p>Prior to first occupation, details of the cycle parking facilities, as approved,<span style="text-indent: -18pt;">&nbsp;shall be implemented. The development shall not be occupied until the approved details have been implemented. Thereafter, the cycle parking facilities shall be permanently retained.</span></p>

<p>The proposed development shall achieve security standards (based on Secured by Design principles) to the satisfaction of the local authority &amp; Metropolitan Police, details of which shall be provided to the Local Planning Authority for its written approval prior to the first occupation of the approved development. All security measures applied to the approved development shall be permanently retained thereafter.&nbsp;</p>

<p>Prior to first occupation,&nbsp;<span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">the
applicant is required to submit an on‑street overnight parking stress survey
for the surrounding streets, undertaken in accordance with the Lambeth Parking
Survey methodology.&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">The survey must be carried out by an independent, suitably qualified
company. The methodology, survey area, and scope must be agreed with the Local
Highway Authority (LHA) prior to the survey being undertaken.</span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;
